name: Gusto
summary: Payroll, benefits and HR in one friendly platform. Automated tax filings, employee onboarding and time tracking — run payroll for your whole team in just a few clicks.
best_for: US small businesses that want genuinely easy full-service payroll, benefits and tax compliance in one place
skip_if: you want one vendor for staff outside the US — since 1 May 2026 Gusto refers new international hires to Remote's employer-of-record service (from about $599 per employee a month, a separate contract) — or you need enterprise, multi-entity HR
honest_knock: The base-plus-per-employee model is transparent but adds up, and Gusto is US-only — excellent for straightforward US payroll and benefits, but not the pick for international teams or complex multi-entity HR.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month plus $6 per person (single-state payroll)
pricing.notes: Read in a browser on gusto.com/product/pricing on 16 October 2026; the page blocks plain fetches. On the 'Pay My Team' tab, Simple is $49 a month plus $6 per person for single-state payroll, Plus $80 plus $12 per person with multi-state payroll, next-day pay and time tracking, and Premium $180 plus $22 per person with premium account support and HR guidance. The Contractor Only card ($35 a month plus $6 per contractor, base fee waived in a promotion, on our 5 September 2026 reading) is no longer on the page; the 'Pay Myself' tab now shows Solo, for solopreneurs, at $49 a month plus $6 per person. US contractors are billed at the plan's per-person rate only in months you pay them. No contracts, free setup, month-to-month.
